semiconductor_relevance: High — POSAS GmbH specializes in gas delivery solutions and monitoring equipment critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: POSAS GmbH provides advanced precursor and dopant gas delivery solutions, along with monitoring equipment to enhance overall equipment efficiency in semiconductor fabrication. Their offerings include generators, analyzers, and specialized sensors for precise gas delivery and process control.
capabilities: Precursor and dopant gas delivery systems
Gas mixing systems for epitaxy and ALD
Chemical composition monitoring using IR and UV technology

regional_presence.Europe: POSAS GmbH is a channel partner for Veeco Flow Technology Products in Europe.
